title: CreateTiledMosaic
description: Render a 3-D image volume with optional Rgb overlay.

input_image.description: Main input is a 3-D grayscale image.
input_image.title: Input Image

rgb_image.description: An optional Rgb image can be added as an overlay. It must have the same image geometry as the input grayscale image.
rgb_image.title: Rgb Image

mask_image.description: Specifies the ROI of the RGB voxels used.
mask_image.title: Mask Image

alpha.description: If an Rgb image is provided, render the overlay using the specified alpha parameter.
alpha.title: Alpha

functional_overlay.description: A functional overlay can be specified using both and rgb image and a mask specifying where that rgb image should be applied. Both images must have the same image geometry as the input image. Optionally, an alpha parameter can be specified.
functional_overlay.title: Functional Overlay

output.description: The output is the tiled mosaic image. The format must support the specific data type: floating point images without RGB overlays, Rgb images with intensities scaled to [0,255] if overlays are present.
output.title: Output Tiled Mosaic Image

tile_geometry.description: The tile geometry specifies the number of rows and columns in the output image. For example, specifying '5x10' renders 5 rows by 10 columns of slices.
tile_geometry.title: Tile Geometry

direction.description: Specifies the direction of the slices. Can be based on image storage in memory or aligned physical space. Defaults to z-direction if unspecified.
direction.title: Direction

pad_or_crop.description: Specify padding or cropping with a voxel-width boundary for each slice. Padding uses a specified constant value. Cropping pads with negative voxel-widths.
pad_or_crop.title: Pad or Crop

slices.description: Control over which slices to render. Specify slices directly or incrementally with optional start and end slices.
slices.title: Slices

flip_slice.description: Flip individual slice images horizontally and/or vertically.
flip_slice.title: Flip Slice

permute_axes.description: Permute (or swap) the axes of the individual slice images.
permute_axes.title: Permute Axes
